name: Vit lon um bau
summary: Vit lon um bau is fertilized duck egg stewed with gourd, eaten with a green jackfruit salad, mít trộn. It is the Da Nang plate people cross town for.
origin: Da Nang. The egg is cooked in the stew. This is a lunch plate near Chi Lăng stadium, not a spoon of raw egg.
howToEat: Order the stew and the jackfruit salad together. The salad is half the plate.
Go hungry and sit down. It is too much food for a beach snack.
The stall is on Ngô Gia Tự. Ask which door is the busy one when you are on the street.
where: Ngô Gia Tự, near Chi Lăng stadium. The stall is the address.
seoTitle: Vit lon um bau — stewed balut in Da Nang
seoDescription: Vit lon um bau is balut stewed with gourd, eaten with jackfruit salad. In Da Nang the stall is on Ngo Gia Tu near Chi Lang stadium. Go hungry and sit down.
